title: Over 20,000 Palestinian Students Killed in Three Years of Conflict
detail: Palestinian education authorities report that more than 20,000 students have been killed across Gaza and the occupied West Bank during three years of conflict since October 7, 2023. The figure underscores the devastating toll on the Palestinian education system, with thousands of schools damaged or destroyed and hundreds of thousands of children displaced from their studies.

title: West Bank Schools Close on October 7 Anniversary Amid Settler Violence Fears
detail: West Bank schools closed on the October 7 anniversary as Palestinian communities feared settler violence. The school closures disrupted education for Palestinian students across the territory, as families and local authorities decided the risk of settler attacks was too high to keep schools open on the sensitive date marking three years since the Hamas attack on Israel.

title: Israeli Military Evacuates Illegal Settler Outpost Near Susiya; Six Arrested
detail: Israeli military forces evacuated an illegal settler outpost near Susiya in the southern West Bank, resulting in several settlers being injured and six arrested during the operation. The evacuation of the unauthorized outpost was met with resistance from settlers, with confrontations breaking out as soldiers carried out the removal. The incident occurred as tensions were heightened across the West Bank on the October 7 anniversary.

title: Palestinian Man Shot Dead by Israeli Forces During Olive Harvest in West Bank
detail: A 44-year-old Palestinian man was shot dead by Israeli forces during an olive harvest in the West Bank, according to reports. The killing occurred as Palestinians were conducting the annual olive harvest, a seasonal practice that has increasingly been the site of confrontations involving Israeli forces and settlers in the occupied territory.
